messages.subject: side-by-side reactive images
parts:
Hey all, learning my way through Shiny and I've come upon something I can't seem to tackle on my own.

My program takes a text input, and looks for filenames.  If it finds a name of a .png file in the appropriate folder in the project, it pushes the image to A1 and A1a (successfully).

Unfortunately, they are stacked on top of each other.  I want to be able to organize images side by side(and eventually 4x4).

Thanks

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("testing image reactivity"),
  
  fluidRow(
    column(4, wellPanel(
      textInput("command", "Command", "enter your command here..."),verbatimTextOutput("dialog")
    )),
    column(4,
           imageOutput("A1",width="100px",height="100px"),
           imageOutput("A1a",width="100px",height="100px")
    )
  )
))
